question: Can a joint-by-joint nonworsening headroom rule replace the R10AN hard-margin deadlock while retaining bounded support-preserving geometric moves and a partial-support standing-height goal?

population.selection: All 600 nonterminal observations in original order.

algorithm.candidates: Original 90 torso candidates, original exact anchors and free-foot placement; no new candidate directions, velocities, blending or IK branches.
algorithm.deficit: For each hip/knee: max(0, 0.02-(original_limit-abs(q))). Original limits and speed bounds still apply to every target.
algorithm.admissibility: No target may increase any joint deficit by more than 1e-12 rad. If any input deficit is positive, the sum of deficits must strictly decrease by more than 1e-12 rad.
algorithm.ranking: Lexicographic minimum of maximum joint deficit, total joint deficit, and the R10AN partial-support-standing-height cost. Compare each rank component with epsilon 1e-12. During deficit recovery geometry cost may increase; this is explicitly retained. Once deficits are zero, require strict geometry cost improvement.
algorithm.geometry: Same anchor residual <=0.0005m, unsupported endpoint nonascending, local free-foot displacement <=0.1*dt, torso-up nondecreasing, 4 rad/s speed and original compiled joint limits.
algorithm.refusal: Explicit no_positive_bearing_plane, no_geometric_candidate, no_nonworsening_headroom_candidate, no_headroom_progress_candidate or no_improving_candidate; never an undeclared fallback.

checks: Synthetic rank and joint-deficit controls before retained-input evaluation.
Independent FK, per-joint deficit, lexicographic selection and original geometric bounds on every selected plan.
Retain all 600 rows, rejection counts and signed original height-cost changes.
No propagation or assumed contact acquisition. The original nonfoot contacts and actuator saturation remain physical uncertainties.
decision_rule: This tests one declared law, with no post-result weight, margin or candidate sweep. A selected plan is not a physical controller or recovery success.
